name: Guardian's Gothic Hall
description: Heavy Gothic stone: ribbed vaults, pointed arches, deep shadow. For the guardian_hall biome. Darker and more imposing than the Escher foyer.
style_notes: Gothic pointed arches instead of Romanesque semicircular. Clustered columns. Grotesque boss details at pillar caps. Tight crosshatch with heavier line weight than escher_foyer. Palette: near-black stone, pale mortar lines, occasional torchlight warm spot.
